en: The Holy Land... Asyl.
I can't believe it. That I'm\nstanding right at the center of\nthe Holy Land War.
The center? Don't get it\ntwisted. This is the shadows.
The shadows of history that\nwill never see the light of day.
...I can see both sides of your\nargument. But I don't care how\nit looks to outsiders.
For us, this is undoubtedly the\ncenter of our lives.
Whether we want it to be or\nnot... I suppose.
...According to Administrator\nKoro's data,

Hostilities have broken out
between the Rubarika and
Baschen navies about 2km to
the west.
The battle situation appears to\nfavor Rubarika slightly.
To minimize casualties on both\nsides, we must solve the\nmystery of Asyl quickly.
I'm sure Tika is worried as well.
You're right. Let's go,\neveryone...
Verda?
What's wrong?
...Mm. I understand. What\nRicardo says... cannot be\ntraded for Tika's safety...
But, I also wish I could have\ncome with you.

What? You're dissatisfied too?
Looks like that long period of
being stranded made you lose
sight of your duty as a soldier.
This is a war. It's not some kid\nplaying hero.

Making a decision like bringing
a civilian child to the front lines
of a war is something a soldier
should never do.
No, Captain, forgive me. To\nbring up something that has\nalready been decided...
Well, I can't say I don't\nunderstand how Verda feels.

Besides, by Ricardo's logic,
Eve, Verda, and Welch should
have been kept safe on the
ship as well.
Leave Tika behind on the\nship!? What on earth are you\nsaying?!
Big sister Verda...
Whoa, hey, is it really\nsomething to be that shocked\nabout?

We're about to head to the
Holy Land that Rubarika and
Baschen are fighting tooth and
nail to seize.
There's no way in hell I'm\nbringing Tika to a place like\nthat.
...I'm sorry, but I agree with him\non that point.

Historically, battles following
the emergence of a Holy Land
result in even greater
casualties than before.

This time, Rubarika has the
new messenger, Kouya, and
Baschen has that strange
phenomenon that transformed
the witches.
The danger is incomparable to\nanything we've faced before.
He's right. Especially since our\ndestination is an unknown area\nwith absolutely no prior data.

In a Holy Land that your
technology cannot detect,
there are likely countless
unknown traps as well.
I, too, must oppose Tika coming\nalong.
Karlyn... even Henri.
There is no room to argue with\nthe three of them.
I want to respect Verda's\nfeelings in accepting Tika as a\ncomrade, but...

As for me, it is my duty to say
that I cannot allow Tika to be
sent to the front lines of battle
any longer.
Tika.
Yeah.
I'm sorry. Will you wait here for\nus to return?
Euwin!?
Verda, remember what\nhappened at Baschen's Imperial\nCastle.
Baschen's Imperial Castle?
During that battle, Tika's Arms\nwere destroyed.

If Valka hadn't saved you from
those beasts in Daftes, what
do you think would have
happened to Tika?
It's true that Tika has always\nfought alongside us.
But that's only because of the\npower of this Arms you\ncreated, Verda.

If her Arms were to break deep
within the Holy Land, Tika
would be left completely
defenseless, thrown straight
into the battlefield.
In that case... if it comes to\nthat, Coro can just store her!
I am sorry. That is impossible.
I thought as much.
Yes. I cannot scan the interior\nof the Holy Land, Asyl, at all.

Ideally, I'd transport everyone
to the deepest part at once,
but since I can't, we must
assume storage is also
impossible.
...Verda. I understand how you\nfeel, but not here.
...Thank you, Sister Verda.
I'm going to stay.
Tika...
I can't fight alone. I don't want\nto make everyone worry, and\nbesides...
I'll be safe if I'm with Coro.
I see... You're right.
I'll stay here and wait for\neveryone to come back.

So... please come back safe
and sound without getting hurt.
The battle isn't over until we're
all home.
Exactly. No matter what\nhappens ahead, everyone has\nto return here at least once.
Even if we blow the Holy Land\nto bits, there's still more to\ncome.
This isn't the final battle, so\nthings like this happen\nsometimes.
All right...
Tika, we're heading out. Be a\ngood girl and wait for us.
Okay! Verda, please be careful\ntoo!
Leave it to me. I will wait for\nthe Captains' return alongside\nTika and Rekoro.
So, it's decided.
We're running out of time. Let's\nmove.
...So everything, from start to\nfinish, is just playing into their\nhands.
What's wrong?
...I'm just feeling depressed\nthinking about what lies ahead.
Is that so? Well, as long as\nyou're okay.

This place will become a
battlefield soon. There's no
telling what's happening inside
Asyl, either.
Don't you lot get careless.\nLet's go.

...You're acting like the leader
now, but aren't you a General?
Shouldn't you be leading the
Rubarika army?
Someone else is leading them.\nMy job right now is to crush\nAsyl.
Someone else...? You mean the\nKing of Rubarika?

Huh? There's no way an
incompetent like him could hold
his own against the current
Baschen.

Taking advantage of having
Koya, he's the kind of guy who
treats military deployment like
a piece of shit, feeding in
forces bit by bit on a national
scale.
Then who on earth is it?
I'll tell you that once the Holy\nLand War is over.

Let's move. I've heard the path
ahead is such a demon's den,
even those Baschen beasts will
look cute by comparison.
Y-yes. Understood.
Welch, don't go messing around\nwith strange things, okay?
I can't make any promises.
Hey!
Dr. Belda. What is the matter?\nYou have been silent for some\ntime now.
...I have been preoccupied with\nwhat Ricardo said.
What do you mean by that?
Can't you see it, Valka?
Hmm?
Ricardo has been in contact\nwith advanced planetary\ncivilizations.

His knowledge of the armor
and the captain's ship makes it
clear. He is undoubtedly from
an advanced planet.

If that is the case, he should
possess even more massive
means to destroy the Holy
Land.
...I see.

His obsession with Tika might
actually stem from the
possibility that he is an
acquaintance of hers.

But even so, I don't get why
he'd hide his face, or why he's
forcing the Holy Land War to
an end so aggressively.
I do not believe his words\nabout prioritizing Tika's safety\nare a lie, but...
Even so, the way he protects\nTika is far too indirect.
If he knows that ending the\nHoly Land War will lead to\nTika's future,
then ending the war and\nensuring Tika's safety are not\nin contradiction...
But the problem is, how did\nRicardo himself come to know\nthat?
Thinking logically, it would mean\nhe, too, is acting under\nsomeone else's will.
Precisely. And most likely, that\nperson is...
Daftes's messenger... or\nsomething like that. I heard her\nname is Elaine...
If Ricardo was recruited during\nthe last Holy Land War, then it\nwouldn't be unnatural.
And yet, Ricardo has a reason\nwhy he cannot defy that\nperson.

Despite having enough power
to fight like that, even against
the Witch of Beasts and
Baschen's beasts.
I see.
As for Asyl, he also hints here\nand there that he is receiving\ninformation from someone.
He is a man to be wary of. It\nwould be wise for us to stay\non our guard.
Very well.
Understood.
...To be honest, I am grateful to\nyou two.
Henri & Valka: Hmm?
Hmm?
Eve and the Captain are, well,\ngood people, but...

They are far too
straightforward; I cannot
entrust them with such political
maneuvering.
...Actually, I am not very good\nat those kinds of things...
I think that is not the case.

Valka, you may seem
temperamental, but your
actions always match your
words. You are truly a
first-class warrior.
Really? You think so...? Ehehe...\nA first-class warrior, ehehe...

...You are, how should I put
this, a Nervous Tension.
Perhaps you should act more
like a child and leave things to
others once in a while?
It is a trait I inherited from my\ngrandfather. There is no\nchanging it.
Just what kind of creatures\nare nesting in this holy land?

I mean, why are there things
like this in a holy land that was
supposed to be at the bottom
of the sea!?

They look much newer than the
ones we encountered with
Henri. This is making things
incredibly difficult.

Aaaah, it's such a waste to
destroy them! I want to study
them! Hey, can I take some of
the broken ones back with
me!?

Do as you wish, but you'll have
to hold off the Rubarika and
Baschen forces that come
charging in later all by yourself.

Hmph, stingy! Coro! You can
use communications, right!
Can't you recover these
things!?

I can't! Even this voice
transmission uses ancient radio
waves; I'm struggling just to
keep the connection from
dropping!

If we tried to use matter
transfer in this state, their
molecular structures would be
destroyed!
What a huge wasteeeee!
...Wait, huh? What's that?
What is it? Something is\nmoving through the corridor.

They don't seem to be
attacking... It looks like a
polyhedral object, almost
spherical in shape.
It's particularly strange, even\namong the objects moving\ninside here.

<font color=blue>Valka</font> A quick scan shows this
is a hybrid device, combining
Glyph Arts with mechanical
structures.

The patterns engraved on the
surface seem to be an
application of Teleportation
Glyph Arts.
<font color=blue>Karlyn</font> Teleportation Glyph\nArts?

<font color=blue>Valka</font> It is exactly what the
name implies: an art that
teleports whatever it touches
to an arbitrary location.
I believe it corresponds to the\nglyph engraved on the floor at\nthe entrance of this floor.
<font color=blue>Euwin</font> So you're saying if we\ntouch that, we'll be sent right\nback to the entrance...

<font color=blue>Eve</font> Hey, Coro. Can you analyze
that strange object's
movement, even just from the
video feed?

The passage is narrow; if we
get separated, it'll be a
disaster. I wonder if we can at
least analyze its movement
patterns...
Captain?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "Yes, you're right. This is\nprobably...
Found it! I'll run the\ncalculations now!"
<font color=blue>Eve</font> W-what's wrong?

<font color=blue>Coro</font> "Calculation complete. I
am transferring the
polyhedron's movement pattern
to the Captain's Quad Scanner.

Since it's radio communication,
the data is quite heavy... but I
believe this movement pattern
should work."
<font color=blue>Eve</font> What do you mean by\nthat...?

That's incredibly detailed. Can
you really tell just by looking?
Did you actually calculate it
properly!?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> "I did! I'm certain of it!
Actually, I've been wondering\nabout this for a while now,

The structural philosophy of
this holy land, Asyl, is strikingly
similar to several structures in
the Galactic Federation's
database.
<font color=blue>Ricardo</font> ...
<font color=blue>Verda</font> What are you talking\nabout?

<font color=blue>Coro</font> "The polyhedron in
question is also a spitting
image of the devices installed
in those structures."
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Really? What kind of\nstructures are they?
<font color=blue>Coro</font> 『I don't think you'd\nunderstand even if I told you,\nEve.』
<font color=blue>Eve</font> Why you...! You can't just\nsay something like that and\nleave it at that!
<font color=blue>Ricardo</font> Your analysis is likely\ncorrect.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> 『Huh?』
<font color=blue>Ricardo</font> I hear there are\nbuildings similar to this holy\nland, Asyl, all over the universe.
They're all in remote locations,\nhidden away in strange ways,

and equipped with defense
mechanisms designed to
eliminate intruders without
causing them harm, and so on.
The most prominent example\nis... the <font color=yellow>Purge Temple</font>, or so\nthey say.
<font color=blue>Coro</font> 『Ricardo!?』
<font color=blue>Valka</font> The Purge Temple?!\nGeneral Ricardo! How do you\nknow that name...?
<font color=blue>Ricardo</font> If you want to know\nwhy, run to the depths. I'm not\nsaying a word.
<font color=blue>Ricardo</font> Don't look at me like\nthat. It's not like I know it\nfirsthand.

But I can tell you one thing: the
structure of the Holy Land
Asyl is apparently not
particularly rare in this
universe.
What is... this sphere? It's\ndisgusting...
Disgusting? What is? It's just a\nblack sphere.

I agree... It's like a foul stench
from a Crest... It's certainly not
something that should be in a
place like the Holy Land.
Though it seems some\nslow-witted people can't tell.
You always have to have the\nlast word, don't you!

Strange. It's not exactly a
high-energy body; based on the
analysis, it's just an ordinary
lump of marble.
It has no precious metal value,\nnor can it serve as a catalyst\nfor Crest power.
What on earth is this...?

I don't care. Once I crush this,
the Holy Land of Asyl will
collapse, and the Holy Land
War will end.
And while I'm at it, I'll wipe out\nthat damn calamity plaguing\nDaftine as well.
What do you mean? Besides\nthe Holy Land War, what else\nis eroding this planet...?
I don't have time for your\nwhining. Get out of my way.
I'll crush...
Wait! Don't come any closer!!
Huh!?
Something... something is\ncoming!!
Something...?
My genes... they're being pulled.\nThe genes for my beast\ndisease...
What is this? Is this the "foul\nstench of the crest" Karlyn\nmentioned?
No, this is...
Look! The black stone!!
To approach the rift is\nforbidden.
What was that voice!?
Look, over there!!
What the hell is this thing?! I\nnever heard anything about\nsomething like this being here!!

Something like this, in the Holy
Land... For the sake of such a
thing, Rubarika and Baschen
have...!
It's coming!!
Phew, phew! Th-that was scary,\nbut... but we managed to pull it\noff... phew!
So, was that the final guardian\nof the Holy Land of Asyl?
A guardian, huh...

I hadn't heard anything about
that, but I guess it wouldn't be
strange for someone like that
to exist.
Karlyn? What's wrong?
Didn't it look... somewhat\nsimilar?
Huh?
To that strange form the\nwitches of Korurine were\ntransformed into...
...It certainly had those odd\nwings, but...
That's not all. More than that...\nthe stench of the Gems felt\nsimilar...
You're right... It's like that\nbattle just didn't feel like it had\nany real substance...

But we beat it in the end, so
who cares? Let's just smash
this black thing and get it over
with...
Huh?
What!!
Welch!! Watch out!!
Gwah!!
E-Eu!!
What in the world?! What\nhappened?!
N-No! What is the meaning of\nthis?! He's completely\nunscathed!!
W-Why, why?! There was no\nreaction at all!!
Approaching the rift is not\npermitted.
Eu! Eu, stay with me!!
Ugh... T-This is wrong... His\npower is even greater than\nbefore... What is this guy?!
H-He's coming!!
Unforgivable!
W-what the hell is going on...?!\nNo matter how many I take\ndown, they just keep coming...!
It hurts... it hurts so much...
W-what kind of power is this...?
*Pant*... *pant*! E-everyone,\nplease, recover...!
B-but at this rate... we're just\ngoing to bleed out...!
Karlyn... stay with me, okay...?
I don't feel like we can win at\nall! No matter how much I\nslash, they just...!

I-it's impossible! Teleporting
with the radio cutting in and
out is even more dangerous
than collecting the enemy
remains!
Just... a little longer... If I can\njust smash them... before that\nbastard shows up again...
That would be a problem.
Gah!!

Well, it seems that neither the
black sphere nor its guardian
is so cheap that it can be
destroyed by the likes of you.
...Giv...el.

Hehehe... Not bad at all. I didn't
expect you to be this
persistent. It's a happy... happy
miscalculation.
Watching the movement of\nyour ships in satellite orbit, I\nknew Evelysse hadn't gone far,
But I never imagined she would\ngo out of her way to return.
...Ugh, why...?
It appears this war belongs to\nBaschen, General Ricardo.

The Crown Prince's army,
leading the Exorciser test
subjects I gave my "Beast" and
"Beast Witch," will suppress
Rubarika within days.
D-Don't... don't joke around...!\nNot after we've come this far...!
Givel... you bastard... "Beast"?\n"Servant"? Don't you dare talk\ndown to me, you Crest thief...
A Crest thief, is it?
Heh heh heh... So it was\nMastima standing behind you\nafter all.

You lack the courage to leave
the tower, yet you're as
diligent as ever at dragging
others down. It's quite
troublesome.
...Mastima... Isn't that... the\nname of this planet's moon...?

Ah, Evelysse. Don't worry. It's
just the talk of a gnat with
slightly more attitude than the
rest.
This time, you will stay by my\nside.
Last time, you tried to take a\nshortcut, and I nearly lost my\nchance to rectify the situation.
This time, I will certainly...\n"erase" those so-called\n"comrades" of yours.
...Don't you... dare...!
Don't think things will go your\nway so easily!
Very well! Then struggle all you\nlike.
Guardians. Do not interfere. I\nhave not yet stepped that far\ninto this.
A monster... so you're a\nmonster's comrade!
I shall command you in the\nlanguage of this world so that\nyou may understand! "Die"!!
Dark Star!!
Why...?! I know those hits\nshould have been fatal!
Don't flinch! Keep slashing!
B-but, even when our guns and\nGem Arts land, they're being\nhealed instantly!
Waaaaah! I can't keep up with\nthe analysis at all!! I have no\nidea what's happening!!
Tsk... surprisingly resilient...
But I'm getting bored. It's time\nfor you to disappear.
W-what is happening?!
And together, we shall bring a\ntrue Exorciser down upon this\nplanet!
The black sphere...!
Abnormal Gem energy is...\nflowing into Givel!
It's coming... It's coming!!
It's here!!
That disc...! Not again!
I-I won't let you!!
Ah.
I have waited so long.
Eh... Th-this is!!
I-I won't let you!!
I have waited long enough.
Eh... W-what is this!!

It is the Exorciser! There was
no need to rely on substitutes
like the Witch of Beasts or the
Guardian of the Holy Land!
I have finally found a true\nExorciser! A new world is\nbeginning!
An abnormal Gem reaction is\noscillating between Eve's disc\nand Givel's disc!
I suspect their arts are\nresonating!
Eve! You have to stop the\nsummoning...!
This is wrong, it won't stop!!\nThe energy from the black\nsphere is, my Gem...!
It is useless! Once the\nExorciser has been activated,\nit will never stop!
From here, I shall...!
I won't let you!!
Twinkling Star!!
What...?!
It... it stopped...?!
Wh-what is this! It's...\ncrumbling...!
Y-you! Karlyn Kayson!!
The Gem reaction is\nundergoing abnormal\ncontraction...
Lord Givel... I was grateful to\nyou. I served you with all my\nheart and soul.
But... you have done things\nthat no human should ever do.
You made us do it...
And then, you betrayed us. The\npeople wounded by war, and\nmy very heart!
Y-you bastard!!
...I will not forgive you.
What!? D-Damn you, Karlyn\nKayson! How could you...!
You've certainly done as much\ndamage as you pleased until\nnow...
My comrades...
You're the one who turned the\nWitches of the Beast into\nthose things!!
I know you're planning\nsomething wicked, but I won't\nlet you!
You'll learn the true meaning of\nthe talent you found in the\nWitches of the Beast!
N-No, the Rift is collapsing!
Karlyn! Keep pushing forward!!\nWe absolutely cannot let those\nmonsters enter this world!
I know!!
Stop! The ladder is... Curse\nyou!!
C-Captain... what... happened?
...It's gone.
What?
Administrator Koro... has\nvanished...
W-What do you mean by that!?

Exactly as I said... The ship is
gone. It's nowhere to be found.
It has vanished from satellite
orbit! What on earth is this...!
Vanished...? You say it\nvanished...
Impossible... On the ship, there\nwas... Tika... Coro... Rekoro...
He... Hehehehe...
Hahahaha!! How foolish! It\nmeans you are now in the\nsame position as I am!
What does that... mean...!
Evelysse, Karlyn Kayson.

Your power distorted my
attempt to summon the
Exorciser and the power of the
Holy Land, Asyl!
What do you mean by that...\nWhat on earth... what have you\ndone...!
What have I done?

It was you who did it. You
surely know that messengers
of Daftes descend from the
Moonshadow Ladder.
Do you know why such beings\nappear?
It is quite simple. The\nMoonshadow Ladder creates\nrifts in time and space.

Someone in this universe gets
caught in them and is simply
cast adrift from the past or
the future.
Once cast adrift, there is no\nway to return.
They do not even know where\nthey came from, or where they\nare.
That is the messenger of\nDaftes―a lost child of the\nuniverse.

In such a state, those who
happened to possess
technology unknown to this
Daftine,

And happened to have the
power to pass that knowledge
to others, were merely prized
as messengers.
It was all just a coincidence.

The foolish, primitive
inhabitants of Rubarika and
Baschen simply assigned
meaning to it themselves!
You... you've... got to be kidding\nme...

The Holy Land War, where no
"Emissary" descended. The
"Emissaries of Daftes" who are
utterly useless.
I'm sure there are plenty of\nstories like that in both\nRubarika and Baschen.

And yet, because people like
me or the Emissary of Rubarika
from four years ago appear,
you can't stop fighting!

You are the ones who wasted
lives and fortunes, mouth
agape, thirsting for "talent"
that might never even appear!
You... you...!!
Are you going to kill me?
Even if you kill me, your ships\nwill not return!
Do you think killing me will\nreveal the exit to the rift\nopened in space?
If killing your ass would lead to\nthat, I'd do it right this\nsecond...
...Givel. Does that mean you,\ntoo, were brought to this\nDaftine against your will?
That understanding is not\nincorrect.

Then why did you commit such
a lawless act, forcibly
summoning my kin from Daftes
to this place?
You, who know that suffering\nfirsthand... why?

Why, you ask? Do half-breeds
who cannot even control the
beastification disease dare to
condemn my actions?
Spare me your cheap\nprovocations.
Do those who have fallen to\nbeast and lost their will speak\nof longing for home?
When did I ever say I was\npossessed by such sentiment?
My purpose is to bring the\nExorciser down upon this land!!
The Moonshadow Ladder\ncreates rifts in time and space.

Someone from this universe
caught in those rifts is simply
being thrown from the past or
the future.

Amidst that, someone who
happened to possess
technology not found here in
Daftine,

And happened to have the
power to pass that knowledge
to others, was merely valued
as a user.
It was all just a coincidence.
My goal is to bring the\nExorciser down upon this land!!
The Exorciser? You mean\nthose weird monsters made of\nglowing stakes?
What on earth are they even\nsupposed to be!
Evelysse. Are you being\nserious?
There is no way you wouldn't\nknow about the Exorciser, is\nthere?
Don't be stupid. Why would I\nknow about something as\ndisgusting as that...?
...I cannot tell if you are playing\ndumb or if you truly do not\nknow...!
No! Eve, get back!
Eve!
L-Let go of me...! Y-You...!
Eve!
Wait! Don't go near it! You'll be\nkilled! Can't you see that black\ndisc!
Ugh...!

Good. Stay calm. As expected
of General Ricardo, the
renowned commander of
Rubarika...

Heh heh heh... To think that I,
of all people, would have to
play pretend with such mere
gnats...
I didn't want to do something\nlike this.

But there is too much time
until the next ladder descends.
I doubt you lot will stay quiet
on this planet until then...
I have no choice but to do this.
What do you intend to do with\nEve?!
Nothing. I shall treat her with\nthe utmost care.
At least, until the next ladder\ndescends.

Considering the years that
have passed, waiting until the
next ladder descends is
nothing at all.
Do you... Do you really think I'm\njust going to sit here quietly?!
You will, whether you like it or\nnot. Now, be quiet. You're\ndistracting me.
Aaaah!
Hey! What do you think you're\ndoing to a Girl, you scum!!
This is... just ridiculous!
I've grown tired of hearing the\nbuzzing of gnats.
Soon, Asyl will vanish. You lot\nshall sink into the sea along\nwith it.
Never again shall you cling to\nmy feet.
Asyl will soon vanish. You lot\nshall sink into the sea along\nwith it.
Never again dare to cling to my\nheels.

Hey, wait a damn minute!
Where'd you go?! What the hell
do you think you're doing, you
piece of shiiiiiit!
Eve... Tika... Why... why has it\ncome to this...?
Convergence of the spatial rift\nconfirmed...
...Verda. It seems that even in\na situation like this, we don't\nhave time to wallow.
...Wait, something's wrong.
Disappearance of the rift\nconfirmed... The world has been\nkept pure...
It... it's gone...? Are we... safe?
Whether we're safe or not...
I'm still a bit suspicious!
This is... could it be that Asyl is\ntrying to return to the sea!?

W-Wait a second! You mean
we're trapped!? There wasn't a
single thing in here we could
eat!

There's no food or anything. If
seawater rushes in, we won't
even be able to breathe before
we kick the bucket. Stop your
